policy: No defect is closed without a source commit, reproducible passing test, result, and evidence reference. Android 9 (API 28) is the minimum supported platform. No commercial release until all 90 defects and device acceptance gates pass.

phases.P1: Core accounting, unified posting, subledger reconciliation and financial statements
phases.P2: Bakery/factory operations, costing, inventory, tax, payroll, assets and currencies
phases.P3: Security, backup/restore, licensing, localization, upgrade compatibility and device acceptance

defects.work_note: تم تنفيذ Outbox وربطه بقيود دفتر المصنع وWIP والمرتجعات والعكس، وعمليات المخزون الافتتاحي وشراء الخامات والإنتاج ومبيعات المصنع والتحصيلات وسداد الموردين والمصروفات والهالك. قيود الإنتاج تفصل المواد والأجور والتكاليف الصناعية ثم تحول WIP إلى مخزون الإنتاج التام. لكل حدث payload_version صريح وبصمة SHA-256، مع مطابقة سطرية للحساب والفرع والعملة وسعر الصرف والقيمة الأساسية. رُفع مخطط المصنع إلى v13 والنسخ الاحتياطي إلى v11، مع ترحيل إضافي يحافظ على أحداث الإصدار السابق. شاشة تسوية الأجور والتكاليف المستحقة، واختبارات CI والتنفيذ الفعلي ما زالت مفتوحة. أضيف التقاط آمن للقيود التاريخية المرحلة قبل Outbox على دفعات من 100 قيد، دون تعديل القيود الأصلية؛ تُلتقط القيود المتوازنة فقط وتظل القيود غير الصالحة ظاهرة في تقرير النواقص. أضيف اختبار يثبت عدم تكرار الالتقاط وعدم تغيير التاريخ. الاختبارات الآلية ما زالت قيد التشغيل ولم يُغلق البند. أُضيفت معالجة القيود التاريخية المعكوسة: يلتقط النظام القيد الأصلي المعكوس وقيده العكسي المرحل معًا، ويُلتقط القيد الأصلي قبل تغيير حالته عند عكس قيد قديم بعد التحديث. هذا يمنع ترحيل القيد العكسي منفردًا وإفساد الأرصدة. أضيف اختبار لهذه الحالة؛ لم تُشغّل اختبارات Android instrumented بعد.
defects.title: Factory journal transactional outbox
defects.scope: Capture each committed factory journal header and immutable line payload in the same transaction as the source journal. Preserve source identity and provide retry/dead-letter state without modifying historical source records.
acceptance_criteria: Outbox event and source journal either both commit or both roll back
Event identity is deterministic and unique per source journal
Each event stores an explicit payload_version and rejects unsupported versions
Payload snapshot is immutable and includes every source line
Worker can resume PENDING and PROCESSING events after process termination
Destination success is recorded only after GeneralLedger.post commits
A retry after destination commit but before source acknowledgement returns the same posted entry without duplication
Unknown account mappings, inactive accounts, missing branches, inactive currencies and closed periods do not post
Retries use bounded backoff and eventually enter DEAD_LETTER
Reconciliation reports source, outbox and destination references and amounts
Legacy reversed source journals and their posted reversal entries are both captured in order
tests_required: crash after destination commit before source acknowledgement
reverse legacy journal capture before source status changes

defects.work_note: أضيفت شاشة ربط صريح و15 mapping ثابتًا تمت مراجعتها، وتُزرع فقط عند عملة أساس SDG بعد التحقق من أسماء الحسابات وأنواعها وأطرافها الطبيعية والفرع MAIN، ولا تستبدل تعديل المشرف. عملة مصدر المصنع مثبتة SDG. عند اختلاف عملة الأساس يلزم إدخال سعر تحويل موثق؛ يمنع الترحيل بسعر 1:1 غير موثق. أضيفت idempotency وإعادة مطابقة آمنة وdead-letter recovery. اختبارات Android تغطي الترحيل والتكرار والتعافي وتعارض الحمولة والحساب غير المربوط والفترة المغلقة وسعر الصرف وفروقات المطابقة وترحيل قاعدة v12 إلى v13؛ لم تُشغّل بعد على CI.
defects.title: Explicit factory-to-GL account mapping and idempotent posting
defects.scope: Resolve each exact source account label to an explicitly configured target chart-of-accounts code, branch, currency and rational exchange rate. Never infer target accounts from translated display names.
acceptance_criteria: Each source account maps explicitly to one active target account code
Branch and transaction currency are explicit and validated
Mapping snapshot is frozen before first destination posting attempt
Stable source type, source id, entry reference and idempotency key are generated
Same key and same payload returns already-posted result
Same key with changed payload is rejected without changing destination balances
Unmapped or inactive accounts are visible for correction and cannot post
Reconciliation detects missing, duplicated or amount-mismatched destination journals

defects.title: Balanced journal validation
defects.scope: Every GL posting path must reject journals with fewer than two lines, one-sided lines, negative amounts, overflow, or unequal base-currency debit and credit.
acceptance_criteria: unbalanced and one-line journals are rejected before writes; failed posts leave no journal, lines, idempotency or audit rows.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.
defects.work_note: أضيف اختبار وحدات مستقل GeneralLedgerValidationTest يغطي القيد المتوازن، الحد الأدنى لعدد السطور، انعدام إجمالي المدين أو الدائن، عدم تساوي الإجماليين، الإجماليات السالبة، وصحة السطر أحادي الجانب ورفض السطر ذي المدين والدائن معاً أو المبلغ السالب أو مقام سعر الصرف الصفري. هذا يغطي قواعد التحقق الخالصة فقط؛ لا يُغلق D03 قبل إضافة اختبار قاعدة بيانات يثبت rollback وعدم إنشاء رأس/سطور/مفتاح idempotency/audit عند فشل الترحيل، ثم نجاح API 28 وAPI 35.

defects.title: Sales-to-GL posting
defects.scope: Every completed bakery and factory sale must create one traceable balanced GL journal using configured accounts and the sale's actual payment split.
acceptance_criteria: cash, Bankak, bank, credit and mixed-tender sales post exactly once; source sale and GL references reconcile.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Receipt-to-GL posting
defects.scope: Customer receipts and allocations must post to cash or bank and reduce receivables without changing the source receipt.
acceptance_criteria: full and partial receipts post once; unallocated and allocated balances reconcile to customer subledger.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Purchases-to-GL posting
defects.scope: Supplier invoices and material purchases must update inventory or expense and accounts payable through a balanced GL journal.
acceptance_criteria: invoice, tax, payable and inventory amounts reconcile; failed posting rolls back all destination rows.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Expense-to-GL posting
defects.scope: Every approved operating expense must post to the correct expense and cash, bank or payable account.
acceptance_criteria: expense source and GL post once; invalid account, closed period or invalid amount is rejected.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Production-to-GL posting
defects.scope: Material consumption, WIP, labor, overhead, finished goods and production variances must post with source batch references.
acceptance_criteria: production issue and completion entries balance; WIP and finished inventory reconcile to batch costs.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Idempotent source posting
defects.scope: All source posting services must use stable idempotency keys and reject changed payloads under an existing key.
acceptance_criteria: same key and payload returns the original result; same key with changed payload creates no new balances.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Immutable source references
defects.scope: Every GL journal must retain a stable source type, source ID, document reference and traceable audit record.
acceptance_criteria: source reference is unique per posting; source-to-GL drill-down resolves the exact source document.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Document-linked reversals
defects.scope: Corrections must use full reversing journals and replacement documents rather than deleting or silently editing posted entries.
acceptance_criteria: original remains posted; reversal is equal and opposite; duplicate reversal is prevented; source document status reconciles.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Financial period close
defects.scope: Authorized users must close and reopen accounting periods with an audit trail and controlled close checks.
acceptance_criteria: closed status persists; close/reopen actions record actor and timestamp; close is blocked when required controls fail.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.
defects.work_note: أضيفت صلاحيات PERIOD_CLOSE وPERIOD_REOPEN للأدوار OWNER وMANAGER، وصلاحية الإقفال للمحاسب، مع فحص صلاحية المستخدم والفرع داخل FinancialPeriodService وسجل تدقيق للإقفال وإعادة الفتح. أضيف اختبار Android instrumented لدورة الإقفال وإعادة الفتح ورفض المستخدم غير المصرح. لم يعتمد البند بعد؛ ينتظر نجاح CI واختبار واجهة الاستخدام ومسار الإقفال الفعلي.

defects.title: Closed-period posting block
defects.scope: No source or manual posting may create a GL entry in a closed or nonexistent financial period.
acceptance_criteria: posting to closed or missing period is rejected atomically; retryable source event remains visible.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Trial balance reconciliation
defects.scope: Trial balance totals must derive only from posted GL lines and balance to the ledger control totals.
acceptance_criteria: debit equals credit in base currency; drafts and reversed entries are treated consistently; report totals match SQL ledger totals.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Customer subledger reconciliation
defects.scope: Customer balances, invoices, credits and receipts must reconcile to the GL receivables control account.
acceptance_criteria: per-customer open balance equals subledger movement and GL control total; differences are reported, not hidden.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.
defects.work_note: أضيف تحقق مركزي داخل قاعدة المصنع يطابق معرّف العميل/المورد بالاسم قبل البيع والتحصيل وفاتورة الشراء وسداد المورد. أصبح تجميع مديونية العميل والتحصيل والمرتجعات يعتمد على customer_master_id مع توافق للسجلات التاريخية ذات المعرّف صفر. أضيف اختبار Android instrumented يرفض تمرير اسم طرف مختلف عن المعرّف في العمليات الأربع ويتحقق من عدم إنشاء مستندات جزئية. commits: d5878d316a268db3a2c12918517bcae7dba8795e وa7a219656846c6ce381ee7ae54f22ce41f8f2049. لم تُعتمد النتيجة بعد؛ ينتظر اختبار API 28 وAPI 35، لذلك لا يوجد evidence ولا إغلاق للبند.

defects.title: Supplier subledger reconciliation
defects.scope: Supplier invoices, credits, payments and allocations must reconcile to the GL payables control account.
acceptance_criteria: per-supplier payable equals subledger movement and GL control total; unallocated payments remain identifiable.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.
defects.work_note: أضيف تحقق مركزي داخل قاعدة المصنع يطابق معرّف العميل/المورد بالاسم قبل البيع والتحصيل وفاتورة الشراء وسداد المورد. أصبح تجميع مديونية العميل والتحصيل والمرتجعات يعتمد على customer_master_id مع توافق للسجلات التاريخية ذات المعرّف صفر. أضيف اختبار Android instrumented يرفض تمرير اسم طرف مختلف عن المعرّف في العمليات الأربع ويتحقق من عدم إنشاء مستندات جزئية. commits: d5878d316a268db3a2c12918517bcae7dba8795e وa7a219656846c6ce381ee7ae54f22ce41f8f2049. لم تُعتمد النتيجة بعد؛ ينتظر اختبار API 28 وAPI 35، لذلك لا يوجد evidence ولا إغلاق للبند.

defects.title: Cash and Bankak reconciliation
defects.scope: Cash drawers, Bankak references, bank transfers and closing balances must reconcile to their GL accounts.
acceptance_criteria: opening plus receipts less payments and adjustments equals closing balance; duplicate references are detected.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Inventory-to-GL reconciliation
defects.scope: Inventory quantities and valuation must reconcile to inventory control accounts under one documented costing policy.
acceptance_criteria: quantity and value movements reconcile by item and location; adjustments and cost of goods sold are traceable.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Tax control reconciliation
defects.scope: Output tax, input tax, payable tax and tax credits must reconcile between source documents and GL control accounts.
acceptance_criteria: tax totals are grouped by jurisdiction and tax code; unposted or mismatched tax is reported.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Returns and credit notes
defects.scope: Sales and purchase returns must reverse financial, tax, receivable/payable and stock effects exactly once.
acceptance_criteria: return references original document; quantities and values cannot exceed eligible remainder; repeat return is blocked.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Supplier partial payments
defects.scope: Supplier payments must support allocation across invoices and preserve unapplied balances.
acceptance_criteria: partial and multi-invoice allocations reconcile to cash/bank and payables; over-allocation is rejected.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Customer partial settlements
defects.scope: Customer receipts must support partial allocation, advance balances and collection history.
acceptance_criteria: allocated and unallocated amounts reconcile; customer balance and aging update without duplication.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Income statement
defects.scope: The income statement must derive revenue, returns, cost of sales and expenses from posted accounts for a selected period.
acceptance_criteria: report period and account mapping are explicit; net income matches a verified fixture and GL balances.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Statement of financial position
defects.scope: The balance sheet must report assets, liabilities and equity with retained earnings and a balanced accounting equation.
acceptance_criteria: assets equal liabilities plus equity; opening balances and period profit are handled consistently.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Cash flow statement
defects.scope: Cash flows must classify operating, investing and financing movements and reconcile opening to closing cash.
acceptance_criteria: net cash movement equals change in cash and cash equivalents; noncash entries are excluded or adjusted.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Inventory valuation policy
defects.scope: A single documented and consistently applied costing method must govern receipts, issues, WIP and finished goods.
acceptance_criteria: cost method is explicit per company; item valuation and COGS use the same method; legacy stock is migrated without silent repricing.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Material issue costing
defects.scope: Material issues must be linked to production orders and valued using the approved inventory cost method.
acceptance_criteria: issued quantity and value match the batch consumption record and inventory ledger; insufficient stock is rejected.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Labor absorption
defects.scope: Direct labor time and payroll cost must be allocated to production batches using approved rates.
acceptance_criteria: labor allocation is traceable by employee, period and batch; allocated labor reconciles to payroll and WIP.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Manufacturing overhead absorption
defects.scope: Indirect factory costs such as energy and machine costs must be allocated by a documented driver.
acceptance_criteria: overhead rate and driver are stored; allocated amount reconciles to actual overhead and batch cost.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: WIP and finished-goods costing
defects.scope: Completion must transfer the actual accumulated WIP cost into finished inventory without duplication.
acceptance_criteria: finished-goods cost equals materials, labor and overhead less scrap/variance treatment; WIP clears correctly.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Partial production amendments
defects.scope: Changes to partially completed orders must preserve prior consumption and recalculate only remaining quantities.
acceptance_criteria: amendments retain audit history; prior issues are not replayed; revised plan and actual cost reconcile.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Production cancellation
defects.scope: Cancellation after posting must reverse remaining WIP, material, labor and overhead effects through traceable entries.
acceptance_criteria: posted stages are reversed once; consumed or completed stock is not silently deleted; cancellation leaves reconciled balances.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Negative inventory prevention
defects.scope: All stock issue, transfer, production and sales paths must enforce available quantity under transaction locks.
acceptance_criteria: concurrent and sequential operations cannot create negative stock unless an explicitly authorized policy allows it.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Inventory movement reconciliation
defects.scope: Receipts, issues, transfers, production, sales, returns and adjustments must reconcile to item balances.
acceptance_criteria: opening plus movements equals closing quantity and value for each item/location; no movement is counted twice.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Single-count waste accounting
defects.scope: Production spoilage and waste must reduce stock and affect cost once, with reason and source batch.
acceptance_criteria: waste quantity, value and GL impact occur once; waste is not also included in an unrelated expense deduction.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Production and material returns
defects.scope: Unused material and rejected/returned finished goods must reverse the original movement using linked quantities and costs.
acceptance_criteria: return cannot exceed issued/produced quantity; cost and inventory are restored at original valuation; duplicate return blocked.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Bakery-factory stock reconciliation
defects.scope: Shared items and inter-unit transfers must reconcile between separate bakery and factory databases.
acceptance_criteria: each transfer has paired source/destination references; both ledgers agree on quantity and value after retries.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Sales currency model
defects.scope: Sales documents must store transaction currency, functional currency, dated exchange rate and base-currency values.
acceptance_criteria: currency and rate are persisted per document; historic documents retain original values after rate changes.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Receipt currency model
defects.scope: Receipts and allocations must retain received currency, invoice currency, exchange rate and realized difference.
acceptance_criteria: cross-currency allocations are traceable and calculate realized FX differences correctly.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Cash and bank currency model
defects.scope: Cash and bank accounts must maintain currency-specific balances and base-currency valuation.
acceptance_criteria: foreign-currency movements retain currency and dated rate; account balances reconcile by currency and base currency.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Expense currency model
defects.scope: Expenses must retain source currency, tax currency where applicable, exchange rate and base amount.
acceptance_criteria: expense amount is not overwritten by conversion; base value and rate are auditable.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Foreign-exchange differences
defects.scope: Realized and unrealized exchange differences must post to designated gain/loss accounts using dated rates.
acceptance_criteria: difference is calculated without floating point; GL postings balance and are traceable to source rates.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Historical currency preservation
defects.scope: Currency schema upgrades must preserve every historical amount and original currency meaning.
acceptance_criteria: migration is additive and idempotent; no historical amount is reinterpreted or silently converted.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Tax engine on sales
defects.scope: Tax calculation must be attached to sales lines and invoice totals with effective-dated jurisdiction rules.
acceptance_criteria: line and invoice tax are reproducible from saved rule/version; exemptions and rounding are explicit.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Tax engine on purchases
defects.scope: Input tax calculation must be attached to supplier invoice lines and retained for recoverability rules.
acceptance_criteria: purchase tax and recoverable portion are explicit; unsupported jurisdiction rules cannot auto-apply.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Output tax GL posting
defects.scope: Sales output tax must post to the correct tax liability account and reconcile to tax reports.
acceptance_criteria: tax liability is separated from revenue and posted once per invoice/credit note.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Input tax GL posting
defects.scope: Recoverable input tax must post to the designated tax receivable account and reconcile to purchase documents.
acceptance_criteria: recoverable and nonrecoverable tax are distinguished; GL and tax report totals agree.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Unverified jurisdiction enforcement
defects.scope: REVIEW_REQUIRED or UNVERIFIED tax profiles must prevent automatic compliance claims and unsupported tax calculation.
acceptance_criteria: unverified profiles are visibly marked and tax auto-posting is blocked or requires explicit configured rule.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Country tax configuration
defects.scope: Each supported country must have documented effective dates, rates, thresholds, exemptions and invoice requirements before activation.
acceptance_criteria: only reviewed country profiles can be enabled; unsupported tax treatment remains disabled.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Tax on returns and credit notes
defects.scope: Returns and credit notes must reverse the original tax treatment and preserve original jurisdiction/rate.
acceptance_criteria: tax reversal matches returned quantity and original invoice tax; repeat credit note is blocked.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Payroll lifecycle
defects.scope: Payroll must cover periods, attendance, advances, deductions, approval, payment and employee statements.
acceptance_criteria: payroll totals reconcile to employee lines and payment records; edits after approval require controlled reversal.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Payroll GL posting
defects.scope: Approved payroll must post gross wages, deductions, advances and net payable/cash to GL once.
acceptance_criteria: payroll posting balances and reconciles by period and employee control totals.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Fixed asset lifecycle
defects.scope: Assets must support acquisition, useful life, depreciation schedule, impairment or disposal and audit history.
acceptance_criteria: asset register reconciles to cost and accumulated depreciation; disposal gain/loss is calculated correctly.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Depreciation and disposal GL posting
defects.scope: Depreciation and disposal must create balanced traceable GL journals in open periods.
acceptance_criteria: monthly depreciation posts once; disposal clears cost and accumulated depreciation and posts gain/loss.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Current APK and guide alignment
defects.scope: The user guide and download page must identify the actual supported APK version and must not advertise an obsolete build as current.
acceptance_criteria: store, guide and artifact version agree; withdrawn versions are clearly marked and not offered as current.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Release change history
defects.scope: Each release must include a complete user-facing change log with migration and compatibility notes.
acceptance_criteria: version history is ordered and identifies changes, fixes, data migration and known limitations.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Implemented-versus-planned documentation
defects.scope: Documentation must distinguish working features, partial features, planned features and unavailable features.
acceptance_criteria: no planned feature is described as released; each claimed capability links to evidence or is labeled planned.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Reproducible accounting acceptance report
defects.scope: A standalone acceptance report must document fixtures, expected values, actual values, test commands and evidence.
acceptance_criteria: independent reviewer can reproduce accounting acceptance from the report and CI artifacts.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: English user guide
defects.scope: Provide complete English guidance for setup, daily operations, accounting, backup, licensing and troubleshooting.
acceptance_criteria: English guide covers every released workflow and matches current UI labels.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Complete bilingual localization
defects.scope: All screens, dialogs, validation messages, invoices, reports and exports must support Arabic and English.
acceptance_criteria: no user-facing hard-coded untranslated strings remain; both language suites pass.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: RTL and LTR layout
defects.scope: Arabic and English layouts must render correctly across forms, tables, dialogs, numbers and printed output.
acceptance_criteria: RTL and LTR layouts preserve alignment, field order and numeric readability on supported screen sizes.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: SQLCipher database encryption
defects.scope: Every operational and enterprise database must use SQLCipher rather than plaintext SQLite.
acceptance_criteria: database opens only through encrypted helper; all app DB files are encrypted at rest.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Plain SQLite rejection
defects.scope: Encrypted database files must not be readable through ordinary SQLite without the application key.
acceptance_criteria: SQLite CLI cannot read protected database content; SQLCipher with correct key can.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Android Keystore key protection
defects.scope: Database encryption keys must be protected using Android Keystore-backed key material and not stored as plaintext secrets.
acceptance_criteria: key material is not present in source, preferences or logs; keystore invalidation is handled safely.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Legacy database migration safety
defects.scope: Database upgrades must be additive, transactional and preserve historical rows, indexes and balances.
acceptance_criteria: upgrade from each supported baseline completes once; rollback or recovery is available on failure.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Encrypted backup tamper detection
defects.scope: Encrypted backup files must detect wrong passwords, truncation and modified ciphertext before restore.
acceptance_criteria: authentication failure occurs before database mutation; no partial restore is possible.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Unified restore policy
defects.scope: Bakery, factory and enterprise database restore must follow one documented validation and recovery policy.
acceptance_criteria: all included DBs are validated together; unsupported versions are rejected consistently.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Atomic pre-restore snapshot
defects.scope: A complete pre-restore snapshot must cover every database and required metadata before any restore begins.
acceptance_criteria: snapshot is created and verified before mutation; failure to snapshot aborts restore.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Atomic restore rollback
defects.scope: A failed restore of any database must restore all databases to their pre-restore state.
acceptance_criteria: forced failure at each restore stage leaves original DBs intact and records recovery outcome.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Complete enterprise data restore
defects.scope: Restore must include users, roles, branches, periods, currencies, tax profiles, audit logs, payroll and assets.
acceptance_criteria: restored record counts and relationships match backup; foreign keys and access controls remain valid.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Server-backed trial identity
defects.scope: Trial entitlement must be anchored to server-side account/device state, not only deletable local preferences.
acceptance_criteria: trial start and expiry are signed or server-verified and survive app data clearing/reinstall within policy.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Trial reset prevention
defects.scope: Reinstalling or clearing local data must not grant a new seven-day trial.
acceptance_criteria: same device/license identity cannot restart trial; server outage follows documented offline policy.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: License gate on every route
defects.scope: Every protected Activity, deep link, notification and navigation path must enforce the same entitlement gate.
acceptance_criteria: expired or unlicensed user cannot reach protected screens by back/home/direct Activity intents.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: License continuity across upgrades and restore
defects.scope: Valid license and entitlement state must survive compatible app upgrades and approved backup restoration.
acceptance_criteria: upgrade and restore retain valid license without extending or shortening term improperly.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Installed-version upgrade preservation
defects.scope: Upgrade from withdrawn 2.8.1/2.8.2 or supported baseline must preserve records and signing identity while applying security policy.
acceptance_criteria: same package and signing certificate; row counts and balances preserved; unsupported old version receives update block when online.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Signing certificate continuity
defects.scope: Review and release APKs must use the approved long-term signing certificate and package identity.
acceptance_criteria: certificate SHA-256 equals approved fingerprint; package/version metadata match; update install succeeds.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Modern Android compatibility
defects.scope: The app must install and launch on Android 15/API 35 and supported target configurations.
acceptance_criteria: API 35 install, launch and core navigation complete without crash or permission regression.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Abrupt shutdown durability
defects.scope: Transactions and backup operations must survive process termination or power interruption without partial records.
acceptance_criteria: database integrity passes after forced process kill; transaction is wholly committed or rolled back.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Low-storage backup and restore
defects.scope: Low storage must not corrupt source databases or leave partially restored files.
acceptance_criteria: insufficient-space errors occur before destructive mutation or trigger full rollback.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Financial report source reconciliation
defects.scope: Every report total must be traceable to underlying documents, subledgers and posted GL entries.
acceptance_criteria: report fixture totals equal independently computed source totals; drafts and duplicates excluded.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: End-to-end daily operation
defects.scope: A full bakery and factory operating day must complete from opening stock through production, sales, collections, returns, waste and close.
acceptance_criteria: quantities, cash, Bankak, credit, expenses, stock and GL reconcile at day close.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Independent accounting review
defects.scope: A qualified reviewer must inspect accounting policies, mappings, financial statements, edge cases and evidence before release.
acceptance_criteria: review findings are resolved or formally accepted; reviewer report and version hash are retained.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Multi-currency product price lists
defects.scope: Product price lists must store a currency per price and support separate lists without overwriting base prices.
acceptance_criteria: each list retains currency and effective date; displayed price matches selected list.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Multi-currency sales invoice
defects.scope: Sales invoices must support selecting transaction currency and a dated exchange rate while retaining base-currency values.
acceptance_criteria: invoice stores currency, rate, transaction amount and base amount; historical invoice remains unchanged after rate updates.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Direct warehouse item adjustment
defects.scope: Warehouse item rows must provide a controlled adjustment action with a reason, user and stock movement record.
acceptance_criteria: adjustment changes quantity through a ledger movement, not direct balance overwrite; audit record is created.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Correct prior goods receipt
defects.scope: Prior goods receipt corrections must use reversal or adjustment documents instead of silent edits.
acceptance_criteria: posted receipt remains immutable; correction links to original and recalculates stock and GL once.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Item movement and valuation card
defects.scope: Each material must expose quantity, value, average cost, receipts, issues, consumption, waste and linked movements.
acceptance_criteria: item card totals reconcile to stock ledger and GL valuation; filters preserve item identity.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Foreign-currency supplier invoice
defects.scope: Supplier invoices must support non-SDG transaction currency and a documented dated FX rate.
acceptance_criteria: invoice retains original currency and rate; stock cost and payable base value reconcile.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Live warehouse movement view
defects.scope: Warehouse screen must show current receipts, issues, adjustments and post-movement balances immediately after save.
acceptance_criteria: saved movement refreshes all affected rows and balances without stale cache or duplicate application.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.

defects.title: Warehouse edit and production synchronization
defects.scope: Warehouse edits, production consumption and stock views must remain synchronized with audit trails and concurrency controls.
acceptance_criteria: concurrent edits cannot overwrite movements; production sees current stock; every adjustment has actor and source reference.
Operation is atomic and auditable; source records and balances remain unchanged on failure.
